title: Forge H2 Schema Registry
description: AI agents must read this registry before using a Forge H2 contract.

conventions.identifier_format: uppercase prefix plus stable number or slug
conventions.human_approval: required for safety, legal, permit, construction and operational control decisions

schemas.name: common
schemas.purpose: Shared types and enums

schemas.name: project_intent
schemas.purpose: Initial project request and normalized requirements

schemas.name: mission_definition
schemas.purpose: Function-like mission contract

schemas.name: quantity
schemas.purpose: SI value, dimension, display unit, uncertainty and provenance

schemas.name: calculation_kernel
schemas.purpose: Deterministic calculation kernel policy and mission bindings

schemas.name: mission_run
schemas.purpose: Immutable execution result

schemas.name: evidence
schemas.purpose: Source, revision, verification and provenance

schemas.name: gate
schemas.purpose: Stage-gate decision and approvals

schemas.name: change_request
schemas.purpose: Impact-controlled project change

schemas.name: agent_definition
schemas.purpose: Role, qualification expectation, authority and consultation contract

schemas.name: agent_invocation
schemas.purpose: Append-only record of one Agent call and position

schemas.name: meeting
schemas.purpose: Structured decision meeting with Agent positions, dissent and actions

schemas.name: decision
schemas.purpose: Auditable decision with human signoff and evidence

schemas.name: professional_profile
schemas.purpose: Verified human expert qualification, scope, authority and independence

schemas.name: knowledge_entry
schemas.purpose: Versioned and provenance-linked knowledge unit

schemas.name: knowledge_catalog
schemas.purpose: Canonical JSON knowledge source catalog

schemas.name: agent_knowledge_database
schemas.purpose: Per-Agent JSON professional knowledge materialized view

schemas.name: formula_library
schemas.purpose: Executable engineering formula records with unit and provenance metadata

schemas.name: professional_foundations
schemas.purpose: Professional certification and textbook foundation catalog

schemas.name: offline_source_register
schemas.purpose: Local source availability and baseline readiness contract

schemas.name: offline_bundle_manifest
schemas.purpose: Hash manifest for portable local-only knowledge bundle

schemas.name: offline_requirements
schemas.purpose: Local data and runtime prerequisites for offline project execution

schemas.name: retrieval_request
schemas.purpose: Agent-scoped, phase-scoped and jurisdiction-scoped knowledge query

schemas.name: retrieval_result
schemas.purpose: Ranked knowledge hits with source and verification trace
